Comment-remediation audit receipt — immutable base d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84; direct parent hopeful-deserved-needletail (d6eb-1c6c-88c3-48f6).

Selection evidence: bounded search freshly enumerated 22 open direct children. Ranking by ascending file-impact count then alias placed the prior completed batch at ranks 1–4 (4, 4, 4, and 5 paths), so the next four were exactly ranks 5–8. Before mutation, each selected leaf was open, unassigned, carried no attestation kind, and had zero retained plan-review results:
- choosy-tin-xerus (e681-2a86-bd33-4c54): 7 files, 72 exact blocks — _store/push_state.py, push.py, s3_doctor.py, staging.py, stamped_lock.py, store_usability.py, sync.py.
- haywire-peridental-roach (9267-c48c-ea53-44eb): 7 files, 78 exact blocks — _snapshot/__init__.py, cache.py, delta_tree.py, gc_trigger.py, git_fetch.py, janitor.py, repo_snapshot.py.
- lawyerly-chondrite-cowbird (7da2-4784-1379-42b8): 7 files, 51 exact blocks — grounding/deps.py; the public-exposure, gitleaks, and conflict-marker detector YAMLs; engine_b.py; oracle.py; resolve.py.
- internal-chargeable-turtledove (0b6c-cf8e-a129-4e52): 8 files, 65 exact blocks — _cli/__init__.py, _help_route.py, _init.py, _jira_onboard.py, _llm_commands.py, _parsers/_common.py, _registry_checks.py, _registry.py.

Persisted per leaf: corrected sub-8k description (6594/6986/5911/6681 chars), exact path set with anchored contract-specific reasons, and six structured command/DD records: immutable-prose-only, exact-leaf-paths, comment-hygiene, focused-contracts, diff-integrity, repository-gates. Material corrections replaced older-SHA broad ranges with owner-qualified stable prose IDs; removed executable code, concise current adapters/branch labels/navigation, and every policy/lint directive; added omitted later module/function/comment blocks; and recorded actual store, snapshot-gate, grounding/code-review, and CLI/library/MCP consumers. Repository-wide __doc__/inspect.getdoc search found no consumer of an allowlisted docstring; push._resolve_conflicted_apply.__doc__ remains explicitly out of scope.

The immutable oracles parse Python with type_comments=True, replace only allowlisted leading owner docstrings, normalize only TypeIgnore.lineno, compare the remaining runtime AST, require directive/shebang physical-line equality, and reject every zero-context hunk whose deleted base lines are outside one exact allowlisted span. The mixed grounding leaf additionally requires each YAML file's ordered non-comment/non-blank runtime lines to remain byte-identical. All leaves require a non-author one-row-per-block TSV with full citations, exact row count, semantic/bloat PASS, and reduced word count.

Exact MCP readback matched all four descriptions, all 29 path/reason rows, and all 24 normalized command triples. Every mutation returned no admission/cross-session warning and push_status.state=ok; all four leaves remain open and unassigned. No source edit, claim, plan review, test gate, transition, close, code commit, or code push was performed. The 12 leaf writes and this receipt are normal MCP ticket-event mutations, which rebar auto-commits and auto-pushes to the tracker remote.
